scenes.text: A graph shows mango 2, orange 1, banana 2. How many fruits altogether? Let us think carefully. Add all three categories. The answer is 5. Great work!
A graph has 3 mangoes and 3 oranges. How many more is the larger group? Let us think carefully. Subtract the smaller count from the larger. The answer is 0. Great work!
One picture means one item. There are 3 banana pictures. How many bananas? Let us think carefully. One picture stands for one item. The answer is 3. Great work!
A graph shows mango 5, orange 2, banana 6. How many fruits altogether? Let us think carefully. Add all three categories. The answer is 13. Great work!
